national_news.title: India to Host 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: India will host the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting under the theme "Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability"
The meeting follows a BRICS Senior Officers’ Meeting of the Environment Working Group and Contact Group on Climate Change and Sustainable Development
It will be presided over by Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav

national_news.title: Ukraine and Russia Exchange Drone and Missile Strikes, 11 Lives Lost
bullets: Ukraine launched over 150 drones targeting Russia, killing 6 people and damaging infrastructure
Russia’s Rostov region suffered 5 casualties from drone attacks on three towns
Total casualties from the exchange amount to 11 on both sides

national_news.title: BWF Badminton World Championships to Begin in New Delhi
bullets: The 2024 BWF Badminton World Championships commenced at Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi, featuring India’s top players such as P.V. Sindhu, Treesa Jolly, Gayatri Gopichand, and Ayush Shetty.
P.V. Sindhu, the former World champion and ninth seed, faced Ireland’s Sophia Noble in the Women’s singles, while the Indian women’s doubles pair competed against Spain’s duo.
The event marks a significant international sporting engagement for India, showcasing the country’s badminton talent on a global stage.

national_news.title: India Draws 2-2 with China in FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup Opener
bullets: India secured a 2-2 draw against China in the opening match of the FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup held in Amstelveen, Netherlands.
Navneet opened the scoring for India, followed by a penalty‑corner goal from Deepika, while China equalised through penalty strokes by Zhang Ying and Ma Ning.
The result marked the start of India’s campaign in the tournament, showcasing competitive performance against a strong Chinese side.

national_news.title: Magnus Carlsen Wins Esports World Cup Chess Title for Second Consecutive Year
bullets: World No.1 Magnus Carlsen, representing Team Liquid, defeated Belarusian Grandmaster Denis Lazavik 2-0 in Paris to secure the title for the second year in a row
The tournament followed a best‑of‑three sets format, with each of the first two sets comprising four games, and Carlsen remained undefeated throughout
American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura finished third after a bronze‑medal match against Alireza Firouzja that was disrupted by technical glitches

national_news.title: FPIs Invest ₹16,621 Crore in Indian Equities in August
bullets: FPIs were net buyers, investing ₹16,621 crore in the first two weeks of August 2026
₹11,199 crore of the inflow came via stock‑exchange purchases, while ₹5,422 crore was through the primary market
The buying trend, driven by resilient domestic fundamentals and strong quarterly earnings, continued from July into August

national_news.title: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY)
bullets: Launched to uplift economically weaker backward classes by providing financial assistance for education, skill development and entrepreneurship
Offers up to ₹1.5 lakh per family for education and skill training, and additional support for self-employment
Eligibility requires families to be below the poverty line and belong to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, or Other Backward Classes

national_news.title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY) – National Employment Scheme
bullets: Launched in 2026 to create employment opportunities for youth across India
Provides skill‑development training and job placement services under a unified platform
Targets both rural and urban unemployed, aiming to reduce unemployment rates nationwide

national_news.title: DRI Busts Illegal Areca Nut Import Network Exploiting SAFTA Duty Exemption
bullets: DRI arrested nine individuals involved in illegal import of areca nuts by exploiting SAFTA duty exemption.
The operation uncovered a potential revenue loss of approximately Rs 2,500 crore for the government.
The case underscores the importance of enforcing duty exemption provisions under SAFTA to safeguard customs revenue.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Rumored to Undergo Major Cabinet Reshuffle Before Year-End
bullets: Speculation of a cabinet reshuffle aimed at consolidating diverse voter bases and strengthening the NDA coalition in Bihar
Potential induction of fresh faces into key ministries to bring new perspectives and address local governance issues
No official confirmation yet; political analysts view the changes as part of a broader strategic realignment ahead of upcoming elections

bihar_news.title: Special Intensive Revision of Electoral Rolls Boosts Bihar Assembly Poll Turnout
bullets: The 2025 Bihar assembly elections saw a record voter turnout after a successful Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
The turnout exceeded that of advanced democracies such as the US, UK and France, according to Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar Patna.
The SIR initiative is credited with enhancing voter registration accuracy and participation in the state.
